defaultPrompt: Improve this by finding and fixing the weakest parts.

interface.longDescription: Gauntlet turns important requests into rigorous, proportionate quality-control workflows. It can execute a task, audit and improve existing work, or build a reusable Gauntlet prompt. It adapts reviewers, benchmarks, validation, stress tests, implementation checks, and stop gates to the task while keeping simple requests simple.
